title: Tricks you into 1 year paid subscribtion
body: After answering a lot of initial setup questions, you are asked to buy a subskription. When you chose one week free trial you are automatically renewed on a 1 year subskription if you dont cancel within the first week. You cant chose to be renewed to the 1 month subskription. That just seems greedy and tricky.
author: Seb73636
